dataset_name: ZecPath HR Screening Question Category Mapping

introduction.description: Collects the candidate's basic introduction and professional background.
introduction.purpose: Understand the candidate's overall background and communication.

education.description: Collects the candidate's educational qualifications and academic background.
education.purpose: Verify educational background relevant to the role.

experience.description: Collects professional, internship, academic, or project experience relevant to the role.
experience.purpose: Evaluate the candidate's relevant experience and practical exposure.

skills.description: Collects technical, professional, and role-specific skills.
skills.purpose: Evaluate whether the candidate has the skills required for the position.

location.description: Collects the candidate's current location and willingness to work from the required location.
location.purpose: Determine whether the candidate satisfies location requirements.

salary.description: Collects the candidate's expected salary or compensation expectations.
salary.purpose: Understand whether the candidate's expectations are compatible with the position.

notice_period.description: Collects the candidate's current notice period and availability to join.
notice_period.purpose: Determine when the candidate can become available for the position.
